## Loading output data from 01_clean

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Load datasets into environment
file_names <- c(
  "02_dat_clean_pam50_filtered_without_NA.tsv",
  "02_dat_clean_all_genes_without_NA.tsv")


clean_pam50_filtered <- read_tsv(str_c(data_path, "02_dat_clean_pam50_filtered.tsv"), 
                                 show_col_types = FALSE)
clean_all_genes  <- read_tsv(str_c(data_path, "02_dat_clean_all_genes.tsv"), 
                             show_col_types = FALSE)

```

## Create the breast cancer subtype label for the controls

```{r}
#Replace the NA values with control
augment_pam50_filtered <- clean_pam50_filtered |> 
  mutate("PAM50 mRNA" = replace_na(clean_pam50_filtered[["PAM50 mRNA"]], "control"))

augment_all_genes <- clean_all_genes |> 
  mutate("PAM50 mRNA" = replace_na(clean_all_genes[["PAM50 mRNA"]], "control"))
```

### Save the final tibbles as tsv files in the data folder

```{r}
data_path = "../data/"
write_tsv(x = augment_pam50_filtered, 
          file = str_c(data_path, "02_dat_augment_pam50_filtered.tsv"))
```

```{r}
data_path = "../data/"
write_tsv(x = augment_all_genes, 
          file = str_c(data_path, "02_dat_augment_all_genes.tsv"))
```
